# ezy Logistic HUB (EzySuite) — Full Project Documentation

> A multi-tenant SaaS Logistics ERP built by ZEYAD. Modules: Operations (shipments),
> Procurement, Inventory/WMS, Sales/CRM, Finance, Domestic Pro (last-mile), plus an
> AI assistant and an OAuth-protected MCP server.
> Public site: https://ezys.lovable.app

## 1. Product overview

ezy Logistic HUB is an end-to-end ERP for logistics, procurement, sales and finance
operations. Every record is isolated per company (`company_id`), access is governed by a
5-tier role system, and new users require manual admin approval before they can use the
platform.

Regional defaults: Country `JO` (Jordan), City `Amman`. Currency reporting in JOD.
Interface: dark navy theme, Notion-style inventory views, Odoo-inspired list/form/kanban
components. Bilingual (Arabic / English).

## 2. Public pages (no login)

- `/` — marketing landing page: hero, stats, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, CTA.
- `/auth` — sign in / sign up / password reset (supports a `next` redirect param).
- `/reset-password` — password reset completion.
- `/privacy` — Privacy Policy (bilingual): data collection, multi-tenant isolation,
  user rights, retention, Jordanian governing law.
- `/terms` — Terms of Service (bilingual): subscription, acceptable use, liability limits.
- `/.lovable/oauth/consent` — OAuth 2.1 consent screen for MCP clients.

## 3. Application modules (login + admin approval required)

### 3.1 Operations / Shipments
- Dashboard with KPIs, status cards, activity feed, task inbox, analytics charts.
- Shipment lifecycle: Created → Picked up → In transit → Out for delivery → Delivered.
- Shipment detail: costs section, tasks section, POD (proof of delivery) upload,
  documents, alerts, and a shipment creation wizard.
- Standard ID prefixes across the system: ORD-, INV-, SHP-, REQ-, PO-, GRN-, EXP-.

### 3.2 Procurement (ERP)
- Requisitions → Purchase Orders → Goods Receipts (GRN) → 3-way matching.
- Blanket orders, return orders, procurement dashboard, internal messages panel,
  workflow check screen that validates the end-to-end chain.

### 3.3 Inventory / WMS
- Inventory dashboard with enterprise KPIs, advanced inventory grid, items, locations.
- Reorder points, stock transfers, cycle counts, batch/lot/serial and expiry tracking,
  valuation and barcode support.
- Notion-style views: list, kanban, calendar, pivot, and form view.
- AI Vision Scanner: capture a photo of a document, invoice or product with the camera;
  the `inventory-vision` function identifies the item, quantity and location and returns
  an Add / Avoid / Put-on-shelf recommendation.

### 3.4 Sales / CRM
- Leads, pipeline, quotations, orders, customers, products, sales dashboard and reports.
- Telecom specialization with Orange Jordan plans and pricing.

### 3.5 Finance
- Expenses, statements, financial reports in JOD, and 3-way match verification.

### 3.6 Domestic Pro (last-mile engine)
- Scan-driven operations: drivers, zones, shelves, warehouse, shipments,
  COD settlements, driver risk scores, risk dashboard, governance events.

### 3.7 Administration
- Company setup, role management, clients, invoices, warehouses, audit log,
  admin console for user approval.

## 4. Cross-cutting systems

### Unified Action Guard
Every blocked action opens a small dialog explaining the exact reason: missing
permission (RBAC), a missing prerequisite (e.g. "add a client first"), or an invalid
workflow state. Inline `GuardBadge` tooltips show requirements before the click.

### AI Assistant
- In-app assistant (floating widget + full page) with conversation history.
- Context-aware: when the user asks about their shipments, orders or invoices, live
  company data is injected into the prompt.
- Markdown rendering and PDF export of any conversation.
- A separate Logistics Assistant handles complex shipping documents and plans, with
  saved plans and action-plan processing.

### Security model
- Row-level security on every table, scoped by `company_id` via `get_user_company_id()`.
- Roles stored in a dedicated `user_roles` table and checked with a `has_role()`
  security-definer function — never on the profile row.
- Admin approval funnel: `is_approved = false` by default; the admin receives an email
  alert on each signup and the applicant receives an acknowledgement email.
- CI gate (`scripts/check-cross-company-security.mjs` + GitHub Action) blocks migrations
  that introduce cross-company leaks, with a formal allowlist file for intentionally
  public tables.
- Centralized `send-alert` function emails critical backend errors with rate limiting.

## 5. Backend functions

| Function | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `ai-assistant` | Streaming context-aware chat over company data |
| `logistics-assistant` | Document-heavy logistics planning assistant |
| `inventory-vision` | Camera/photo recognition for inventory actions |
| `manage-user-approval` | Secure admin approval of pending users |
| `notify-new-signup` | Admin alert + applicant acknowledgement emails |
| `send-alert` | Central critical-error email dispatch (rate limited) |
| `seed-data` | Admin-only demo data seeding |
| `cleanup-staging-users` | Removes staging/test accounts |
| `mcp` | OAuth-protected MCP server endpoint |

## 6. MCP server (for AI clients)

Endpoint: `https://zzwhshjevftnlrcewzas.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp`
Auth: OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration. The assistant acts as the signed-in
user, so all tenant isolation and RBAC still apply.

Tools:
- `whoami` — verify the connection and return the signed-in user.
- `list_shipments` — company shipments, optional status filter.
- `list_orders` — company orders, optional status filter.
- `list_invoices` — company invoices, optional status filter.
- `list_clients` — company clients.

Connect it in ChatGPT, Claude Desktop or Cursor to let an AI read the live workspace.

## 7. Technology

React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui components, React Router,
TanStack Query. Backend on Lovable Cloud (Postgres, auth, storage, edge functions).
AI through the Lovable AI Gateway. Deployment via Lovable publish, with an optional
GitHub Actions workflow for automated builds.
